run_param_sweep: run the controlled generation parameter sweep using ez_grid with the defined GRID configuration
configure_grid_parameters: configure the GRID dictionary with model, optimizer, and inference hyperparameters for a param sweep
set_project_name: set the PROJECT_NAME variable to identify the param sweep run in your tracking system
set_gpu_and_time: set TOTAL_GPUS and HOURS to control resource allocation for the parameter sweep
customize_inference_options: customize inference strategies by modifying the --inference, --topk, and --topp parameters in GRID
